summary: Comprehensive frontend testing completed for Bootlegger Asset Tracker app. All core functionality working correctly including dashboard stats, equipment tracking, callouts management, service history, self-help guides, and user management. Mobile-first responsive design tested across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports.

Equipment search and filter functionality works
Equipment asset detail modal opens and closes correctly
Callouts page displays empty state appropriately
New callout modal opens with + button

History page loads with 39 service records
